part.text:
Fixed in `include/fmt/format.h:2697`. The localized float width calculation counted grouping separators using the whole significand instead of only the integer-part digits (`exp`), overestimating width for values like `119.921` and causing misalignment with `0.295`.

All 20 repository tests pass.
